src.arrow: the female student at the desk
src.desc: A classroom. A female student sits at her desk, raising her hand slightly with a puzzled face. A male teacher stands at the front by the blackboard, holding a textbook.

src.arrow: the man by the window
src.desc: An office. A man stands next to a closed window, hand near the latch, looking back at a woman working at a desk nearby. He is fanning himself with his other hand.

src.arrow: the young woman sitting with the food
src.desc: A dining room in a home. A young woman sits at a table with a bowl of rice, soup and side dishes in front of her, holding chopsticks, hands together. A middle-aged woman stands beside the table smiling, and a friend sits across.

src.arrow: the young man next to the old woman
src.desc: Stairs at a train station. An old woman stands at the bottom of the stairs with a big suitcase. A young man stands next to her, reaching out a hand toward the suitcase.

src.arrow: the girl holding the tickets
src.desc: A school hallway. A girl holds two movie tickets and shows them to a boy, smiling. The boy looks at the tickets.

src.arrow: the man customer pointing at the apples
src.desc: A fruit and vegetable shop. A man customer stands at the counter pointing at a box of apples. A woman shop clerk in an apron stands behind the counter.

src.arrow: the boy at the door
src.desc: The front door of a house in the morning. A boy with a school bag on his back is putting on his shoes at the entrance and waving. His mother stands in the hallway behind him.

src.arrow: the woman without a pen, pointing at the pen
src.desc: A library table. A woman sits with an open notebook but no pen, pointing at a pen lying next to her friend's notebook. Her friend, another woman, is writing with a pencil.

src.arrow: the man holding the umbrella
src.desc: The doorway of a building; heavy rain falling outside. On the left a man holds a long closed umbrella clearly in his right hand, raising it slightly toward the woman beside him. On the right a woman stands with both hands empty, looking out at the rain with a worried face. Only the man has an umbrella.

src.arrow: the student at the door
src.desc: A teacher's office door, half open. A male student stands at the door, bowing slightly. A female teacher sits at a desk inside, looking up at him.

src.arrow: the woman sitting at the table, holding up two fingers
src.desc: A small café. A woman sits at a table with a friend and looks up at a male waiter holding a notepad and a menu. She is holding up two fingers.

src.arrow: the man showing the phone
src.desc: An office break room. A man shows a woman colleague a photo of mountains on his phone, smiling. She is holding a cup of tea.

src.arrow: the woman holding the tennis racket
src.desc: A university campus. A woman holding a tennis racket talks to a man walking with books under his arm.

src.arrow: the young woman at the door with the gift bag
src.desc: The entrance (genkan) of a Japanese house. A young woman stands at the open front door holding a small gift bag, bowing slightly. Her friend stands inside, welcoming her.

src.arrow: the man in the back seat
src.desc: Inside a taxi. A man in a suit sits in the back seat, leaning forward to talk. The driver, an older man in a cap, looks back over his shoulder.

src.arrow: the woman holding out the camera
src.desc: A park with trees. Two young women stand together. One of them holds out a camera to a man walking past, smiling and pointing at herself and her friend.

src.arrow: the man by the door with a bag
src.desc: An office in the evening. A man with a bag on his shoulder stands by the door, bowing slightly toward two colleagues still working at their desks.

src.arrow: the woman holding the tray
src.desc: A company meeting room. A man visitor in a suit sits on a sofa. A woman employee stands next to the low table holding a tray with a cup of tea.

src.arrow: the boy with a hand on his stomach
src.desc: A classroom. A boy stands next to the teacher's desk, one hand on his stomach, looking unwell. A female teacher sits at the desk looking up at him.

src.arrow: the woman customer at the exit
src.desc: The exit of a small restaurant. A woman customer, holding her bag, smiles and bows slightly toward the counter. A male cook in a white apron stands behind the counter. Plain walls: no menus, no signs, no posters, no writing of any kind.
